description.value: A beastly Ink Spirit with a bad temper, likes to eat apricots.
A common Ink Spirit. Apparently some kind of communal organism, it gets lonely when left by itself.
<@eb.key>Can only be blocked by units of the same attribute</>. <@eb.danger>Explodes</> upon being defeated, touching an opposite attribute ally will trigger a <@eb.danger>more violent explosion</>.
